entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I have a problem with my VeloBand Pulse monitor. It's just... it's not working right, and I'm very confused.
I'm sorry to hear that you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, I don't know. It just won't sync with my phone. I've tried, but it's too complicated. Honestly, I **don't have time** for this. I think the product is just **garbage**.

I understand your frustration. Syncing issues can often be resolved with a few quick troubleshooting steps. Would you be open to me transferring you to our technical support team? They can walk you through it.
No, no, please don't. I'm not good with all that stuff. I really **just want money** back for it, that's all. I just want a **refund**. Can't you just help me? I feel so overwhelmed by this.
Okay, I understand. You'd prefer to return the item. Let me just pull up your account information. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 21 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that sounds right. It was a gift.

Alright, one moment please while I review our current return policy for you... Okay, I've checked our system. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process that return immediately for a full refund.
Oh! Really? I thought I was going to be stuck with it. That's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I am sending a pre-paid return shipping label to the email we have on file for you. Simply pack the item back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Your refund will be issued as soon as our warehouse receives it.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. I can do that. Thank you again, David. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure to assist. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
